adapter_policy: The parts of source clips marked in Ingest as a table module of the project database intermediary (qnc-db-broker): ingest_parts (part id, clip, name, IN, OUT), ingest_part_numbers and the view public_ingest_parts. A part lies inside the stored length of a clip of the catalog (qnc-content-read). It owns only its tables and is written only through the intermediary; IngestParts reads and writes them without the caller waiting.
